sections.heading: Udaipur: Zinc, Marble and Instruments
paragraphs: Udaipur's economy rests on tourism, farming and minerals, and Wikipedia lists copper, lead, zinc, silver, phosphate, limestone, talc and marble among the resources that feed its industry. Marble is quarried, processed and exported from the district and is its largest industrial employer. The city also has a cluster of instrument makers that most visitors never see: Wikipedia names Secure Meters, Tempsens and Pyrotech among the electronics and instrumentation firms that together employ more than 6,000 people making meters, sensors, control panels and LED lighting.

The metal that defines the district is zinc. Hindustan Zinc, incorporated from the Metal Corporation of India on 10 January 1966 and now majority-owned by Vedanta, has its base in Udaipur and runs smelters at Chanderiya, Debari and Dariba with mines at Rampura Agucha, Sindesar Khurd, Kayad and Zawar. Debari, north of the city, was commissioned in 1967 as the company's first smelter and converts calcine into refined zinc. In December 2024 the company and RIICO announced a Zinc Park near the Chanderiya, Dariba and Debari operations, the first industrial estate dedicated to zinc, lead, silver and allied metals, with a share of Hindustan Zinc's output reserved for units in the park; an investor consultation followed in Jaipur in November 2025.

sections.heading: Where Electropolished Stainless Fits in Udaipur's Zinc and Metals Plants
paragraphs: A zinc smelter's main circuits are rubber-lined, acid-brick and alloy, not stainless tube, so electropolished stainless has a narrow but real job here: the small-bore lines that keep the chemistry honest. Electrolyte and acid sample lines to analysers, impulse lines to transmitters, dosing lines for reagents and additives, and the sulphuric acid plant's instrument tube all need a clean passive bore that does not adsorb what it is supposed to measure. In these streams the grade matters first: 904L, which we supply electropolished, resists dilute and moderate sulphuric acid and sulphate liquors far better than 316L, and the electropolished bore keeps the sample representative.

The Zinc Park and the galvanising, die-casting and alloy plants planned for it add a second kind of demand. Galvanising lines use acid pickling and flux baths, alloy plants use process cooling and furnace gas analysers, and battery and renewable-energy component makers use deionised water and clean gas. The split is the same as elsewhere: SF4 electropolished 316L to ASME BPE surface designations for high-purity water and clean gas, 904L electropolished for acid and chloride chemistry, and SF1 mechanically polished 304L or 316L for cooling water and utilities.

sections.heading: Instrument Makers and Marble: Two More Udaipur Buyers
paragraphs: Udaipur's meter and sensor makers are a quieter market for hygienic tube. Electronics assembly needs deionised rinse water, clean compressed air and nitrogen to the line, and plating or surface-treatment chemistry, and the water and gas lines to the production floor are specified electropolished for the same reason as in any electronics plant: the bore must not shed particles or grow biofilm into a process measured in parts per million. Thermocouple and sensor makers also use stainless instrument tube as a product input, which is ASTM A269 seamless tube in 316L.

Marble processing uses water in bulk for cutting and polishing and recovers it through settling and filtration, and the stainless it needs is mostly plain utility pipe; an electropolished bore has no role there beyond the odd analyser line. We say so plainly, because a Udaipur buyer who is told to electropolish a slurry-water header is being sold something they do not need. We supply ASTM A270, A269 and A249 tube and ASTM A312 pipe in 304, 304L, 316 and 316L, with 904L electropolished on request.

sections.heading: Documents for a Hindustan Zinc Contractor or an Udaipur Instrument Plant
paragraphs: Large metals companies and their EPC contractors release material against a vendor file, and ours is built for it. Each heat carries an EN 10204 3.1 certificate traced to its heat number, with chemical analysis from a NABL-accredited laboratory. Every length is PMI tested before dispatch, which matters on a site where 316L and 904L lengths are stored together, and each electropolished lot has our internal Ra report. Our quality system is certified to ISO 9001:2015.
If the inspection test plan calls for third-party witness, additional tests or a defined marking format, put it in the enquiry so the quotation already reflects it.

sections.heading: Sending an Udaipur RFQ
paragraphs: Send a complete enquiry and we quote within 24 hours. For smelter, acid plant, Zinc Park, instrument or marble-processing work in Udaipur district, include:
bullets: The unit and system: electrolyte or acid sample lines, dosing, impulse lines, acid plant instrument tube, DI water or clean gas to an electronics line, or utility piping, with stream composition and temperature where known, and whether you are the plant, an EPC contractor or a panel builder.
Grade and finish per line: 904L electropolished for sulphuric acid and sulphate service; SF4 316L for high-purity water, clean gas and sample lines; SF1 304L or 316L for utilities.
Tube OD, wall, length and quantity, with the standard: ASTM A269, A270, A249 or A312, and the fittings they connect to.
Vendor-registration or inspection requirements, and the delivery point at Debari, Zawar, the Zinc Park or an Udaipur industrial area.
